SELECT r.id, r.org_id, r.user_id, r.event_id, r.giver_person_id, r.receiver_person_id, r.related_record_id, r.direction, r.amount, r.pay_time, r.returned_flag, r.remark, r.create_time, r.update_time, e.event_name, giver.person_name AS giver_person_name, receiver.person_name AS receiver_person_name, IF(r.direction = 'RECEIVE', giver.person_name, receiver.person_name) AS person_name, CASE IF(r.direction = 'RECEIVE', giver.relation_type, receiver.relation_type) WHEN 'RELATIVE' THEN '亲属' WHEN 'FRIEND' THEN '朋友' WHEN 'COLLEAGUE' THEN '同事' WHEN 'NEIGHBOR' THEN '邻里' WHEN 'OTHER' THEN '其他' ELSE IF(r.direction = 'RECEIVE', giver.relation_type, receiver.relation_type) END AS relation_type, '-' AS payment_method, '-' AS handler_name FROM gift_record_info_t r LEFT JOIN gift_event_info_t e ON r.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN gift_person_info_t giver ON r.giver_person_id = giver.id LEFT JOIN gift_person_info_t receiver ON r.receiver_person_id = receiver.id
